text:
Emily P: quick sync — Li from HW partner wants to bundle a 12-month reserved capacity private offer with appliance purchase. they want a joint launch 6 weeks from now and a renewal uplift incentive. can we sketch pricing + renewal mechanics?
Samir: copying internal constraints — Dedicated SKU needs 30 day lead for provisioning, pricing approvals take ~10 business days. 6 weeks is tight but doable if we parallelize.
Jordan: agree. We should lock the committed spend tiers and the renewal credit schedule asap. also need to map to sales motions (si attach vs hw resell).
Li Wang: thanks — we need a simple packaging: HW discount + Redwood reserved credits at 20% off list for year1, with a renewal accelerator (extra 5% credit if they renew committed spend >= 80%). Can you propose language for the private offer?
Carmen: two quick asks: 1) can the private offer support tiered consumption (e.g., $X for first 500k tokens, then $Y)? 2) auditability for auditors — need monthly usage breakdown CSV export for customers.
Samir: we can support tiered buckets in the private offer metadata. example config for sales to attach: ```
SKU_CODE: REDWOOD-DED-RES-1Y-HW-BUNDLE
TIER_1: 500000_tokens @ $0.0008
TIER_2: additional_tokens @ $0.0006
OFFERS: 20% off year1
RENEWAL: 5% credit if commit >= 80% year1
```
Jordan: looks good. Pricing ops — are we ok with the token prices? Need approval from pricing lead. will loop in Priya.
Emily P: timeline check — target announcement week of May 18 (6 weeks). action items: Samir to validate provisioning lead times, Jordan to get pricing sign-off, Li to confirm HW shipping windows, Carmen to confirm audit CSV spec, and I'll draft joint statement copy for legal review.
Li Wang: shipping windows look fine, we can hit May 18 if Redwood confirms private offer SKU by next Tue.
PartnerBot: reminder: please complete "marketplace-private-offer-form" by 2026-04-09 to initiate procurement flow — https://redwood.internal/marketplace/forms
Samir: provisioning ok but need a fallback plan: if dedicated capacity misses SLA, we should have a degrade-to-hosted-policy for first 60 days. propose automatic routing to hosted with crediting.
Carmen: agreed. add a clear SLO in the offer: 99.5% availability or customers get pro-rata credits, and fallback routing described. I'll draft wording.
Jordan: one more: renewals cadence — propose auto-notify at 90/60/30 days with a renewal playbook for AEs. also offer a one-time renewal discount if they increase commit by >=20%.
Emily P: perfect. i'll assemble a one-pager and the marketplace form answers, then sync next Tue. thanks all :thumbsup:
